cholect50_grpo_smoke.scope: go/no-go smoke. Proves the platform runs a full GRPO step + eval. NOT a comparable RL result.
cholect50_grpo_smoke.base_model: cholec-sft-qwen3.5-4b (Qwen3.5-4B VLM, model_type qwen3_5; Tinker SFT output, LoRA merged; same checkpoint as verl, Miles, SkyRL)
findings: Platform go/no-go PASSED: generation -> reward -> logprob -> loss -> backward -> optimizer -> step, then eval, all complete on a single Trainium2 NeuronCore (eager mode, LoRA r=16, beta=0.0).
Single-core HBM ceiling is 25.8 GB. Full fine-tune AdamW fp32 states (~41 GB) and the beta ref-model copy (~10 GB) do not fit one NeuronCore, so the smoke uses LoRA (32.5M trainable) + beta=0.0.

No learning happened: reward std = 3.186e-08. The SFT checkpoint emits near-identical completions at temperature 0.7, so GRPO advantages are ~0 and loss is ~0.0003. This is an RL exploration problem, not a platform problem.
Val reward 0.2958 stays at the SFT baseline (0.31875 in the Miles/verl reference). This is expected: 4 steps with near-zero gradient cannot move the model.
Not comparable to verl 0.715 / Miles 0.65125. Those are full 14-16 step full-fine-tune runs; this is a 4-step LoRA smoke on 32 train / 8 val rows.
16 platform/API issues are recorded in TRAINIUM_ISSUES_LOG.md with reproducible error text and native-fix suggestions for torch_neuronx.

cholect50_grpo_full_1epoch.scope: Full 1-epoch run: all 256 train rows (64 steps) + 32-row eval. Platform go/no-go PASSED for a full epoch with real RLVR signal.
cholect50_grpo_full_1epoch.base_model: cholec-sft-qwen3.5-4b (Qwen3.5-4B VLM, model_type qwen3_5; Tinker SFT output, LoRA merged; same checkpoint as verl, Miles, SkyRL)
findings: FULL-EPOCH PLATFORM PASS: 64/64 train steps + 32/32 eval complete on a single Trainium2 NeuronCore (eager, LoRA r=16, beta=0.0).

TDRAM fix VALIDATED: IMAGE_SIZE normalization (854x480) + pad_to_multiple_of=256 kept the forward shape constant; the run passed step 40, the exact point where the previous run died with NERR_RESOURCE (TDRAM exhaustion).
Real RLVR signal (vs the smoke's 3e-8): train reward_std 0.05-0.28 across steps, final step reward 0.3083 / std 0.0988 / loss -0.7667.
Val reward 0.3573 vs SFT baseline 0.31875 = +0.0385 (+12%). GRPO moved the model off the SFT checkpoint.
Still not comparable to verl 0.715 / Miles 0.65125: those are full-fine-tune runs; this is LoRA r=16 + beta=0.0 on one core (no KL, no full optimizer states).
23 platform/API issues recorded in TRAINIUM_ISSUES_LOG.md with reproducible error text and native-fix suggestions.
